**→ http://maker:4001**

**Please try this:**

1. On the **All bookmarks** tab, pick any bookmark and click its **"Archive"** button. It disappears from All bookmarks (the "All" count drops), so your main list stays uncluttered.
2. Click the **Archived** tab at the top — your archived link is kept safely here. Click **"↩ Restore to bookmarks"** on it and it returns to All bookmarks. (There's one example already in Archived to start with.)

The decisions I made here — tell me if they're right:

- **Archiving hides a bookmark from All bookmarks (and from Read later), but never deletes it** — it's tucked away in the Archived tab and fully restorable. This matches "keep it without cluttering the main list."
- On an archived card I only show **Restore** (I hide the read-later and tag-filter actions there), to keep the archive a quiet holding area.
- Archived items **don't appear in your normal searching/sorting of All bookmarks** — you look for them by going to the Archived tab.

Give it a try and let me know if archiving behaves the way you'd want.
